([[Delafield, Wisconsin]]) | college = *[[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball|Illinois]] (2021–2022) *[[Santa Clara Broncos men's basketball|Santa Clara]] (2022–2023) | highlights = *[[West Coast Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|WCC co-Player of the Year]] (2023) *First-team All-[[West Coast Conference|WCC]] (2023) *WCC Newcomer of the Year (2023) *[[Wisconsin Mr. Basketball]] (2021) }} '''Brandin Podziemski''' (born February 25, 2003) is an American of Polish descent [[college basketball]] player for [[Santa Clara Broncos men's basketball|Santa Clara Broncos]] of the [[West Coast Conference]]. He previously played at [[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball|Illinois]]. ==Early life and high school== Podziemski grew up in [[Muskego, Wisconsin]] and attended [[St. John's Northwestern Military Academy]].{{cite web|url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/high-schools/2021/01/28/how-brandin-podziemski-became-top-basketbal-recruit-wisconsin/4275354001/|title=How Brandin Podziemski became a top basketbal recruit in Wisconsin|work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]|date=January 28, 2021|access-date=January 23, 2023}} He was named first team All-State after averaging 22.5 points and 9.3 rebounds per game as a sophomore after not playing on the varsity team as a freshman.{{cite web|url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/high-schools/2020/02/06/brandin-podziemski-more-than-just-shooter-st-johns-basketball/4675625002/|title=Brandin Podziemski is 'more than just a shooter' for St. John's basketball|work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]|date=February 6, 2020|access-date=January 23, 2023}} Podziemski averaged 27.6 points and 9.2 rebounds and repeated as a first team All-State selection during his junior season.{{cite web|url=https://www.kentucky.com/sports/college/kentucky-sports/uk-recruiting/article248960134.html|title=Brandin Podziemski proving himself as a top recruit. What’s next for the UK target?|work=[[Lexington Herald Leader]]|date=February 3, 2021|access-date=January 23, 2023}} He was named [[Wisconsin Mr. Basketball]] as a senior after averaging 35.1 points, 10.0 rebounds, 5.6 assists, and 4.0 steals per game.{{cite web|access-date=January 23, 2023|date=March 6, 2021|title=Brandin Podziemski named 2021 Wisconsin Mr. Basketball recipient|url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/high-schools/2021/03/06/brandin-podziemski-named-2021-wisconsin-mr-basketball-recipient/4610342001/|work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]}} Podziemski was rated a four-star recruit and committed to play college basketball at Illinois over offers from Kentucky, Miami (Fla.), Vanderbilt, and Wake Forest.{{cite web|url=https://www.news-gazette.com/sports/update-podziemski-embraced-challenge-secured-big-ten-opportunity/article_46eb014d-9d88-5ae3-b90c-7b19581f178a.html|title=Podziemski embraced challenge, secured Big Ten opportunity|work=[[The News-Gazette (Champaign–Urbana)|The News-Gazette]]|date=April 13, 2021|access-date=January 23, 2023}} ==College career== Podziemski began his college basketball career with the [[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball|Illinois Fighting Illini]].{{cite web|url=https://www.sfchronicle.com/sports/college/article/Santa-Clara-s-star-guard-went-from-Illinois-17726185.php|title=Santa Clara's star guard went from Illinois' bench to one of WCC's best in a year|work=[[San Francisco Chronicle]]|date=January 20, 2023|access-date=January 23, 2023}} He played in 16 games as a freshman, all off the bench, and averaged 1.4 points per game. After the end of the season, Podziemski entered the NCAA transfer portal.{{cite web|url=http://www.news-gazette.com/sports/report-podziemski-in-portal/article_884082b9-3a6f-594f-85c0-590b51a62147.html|title=Podziemski in portal|first=Scott|last=Richey|work=[[The News-Gazette (Champaign–Urbana)|The News-Gazette]]|date=April 12, 2022|access-date=January 23, 2023}} Podziemski ultimately transferred to Santa Clara.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/illinois/Article/Former-Illinois-guard-Brandin-Podziemski-commits-to-Santa-Clara-basktball-NCAA-Transfer-Portal-187263436/|title=Former Illini guard Brandin Podziemski commits to Santa Clara|first=Joey|last=Wagner|website=[[247Sports.com]]|date=May 6, 2022|access-date=January 23, 2023}} He entered his first season with the Broncos as the team's starting shooting guard.{{cite web|url=https://www.spokesman.com/stories/2023/jan/06/gonzaga-santa-clara-key-matchup-broncos-guard-bran/|title=Gonzaga-Santa Clara key matchup: Broncos guard Brandin Podziemski enjoying breakout season|first=Jim|last=Meehan|work=[[The Spokesman-Review]]|date=January 7, 2023|access-date=January 23, 2023}} Podziemski scored 30 points in Santa Clara's season opener against [[2022–23 Eastern Washington Eagles men's basketball team|Eastern Washington]] as the Broncos won 84-72.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401488780|title=Podziemski scores 30 to lead Santa Clara past EWU 84-72|website=[[ESPN.com]]|publisher=[[Associated Press]]|date=November 8, 2022|access-date=March 1, 2023}} He scored 34 points and grabbed 11 rebounds in the following game against [[2022–23 Georgia Southern Eagles men's basketball team|Georgia Southern]]. At the close of the 2022–23 regular season, he was named WCC co-Player of the Year, sharing the award with [[Drew Timme]] of [[Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball|Gonzaga]].{{cite web|url=https://www.sfchronicle.com/sports/college/article/santa-clara-s-brandin-podziemski-named-wcc-17813844.php|title=Santa Clara's Brandin Podziemski named WCC Co-Player of the Year|work=[[San Francisco Chronicle]]|date=March 1, 2023|access-date=March 1, 2023}} Podziemski declared for the [[2023 NBA draft]] while maintaining his eligibility.{{cite web|url=https://www.mercurynews.com/2023/03/22/santa-clara-standout-brandin-podziemski-declares-for-nba-draft|title=Santa Clara standout Brandin Podziemski declares for NBA Draft|work=[[The Mercury News]]|date=March 22, 2023|access-date=March 24, 2023}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[https://fightingillini.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/brandin-podziemski/12269 Illinois Fighting Illini bio] *[https://www.santaclarabroncos.com/sports/m-baskbl/2022-23/bios/podziemski_brandin_tiwz Santa Clara Broncos bio] {{West Coast Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year navbox}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Podziemski, Brandin}} [[Category:2003 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:American people of Polish descent]] [[Category:Basketball players from Wisconsin]] [[Category:Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball players]] [[Category:Santa Clara Broncos men's basketball players]]
